title: Dynamics 365 ERP apps plugin for Copilot Cowork: work with finance and operations data in Cowork
summary: Hold: the Cowork access path combines an existing policy with a step from the policy-creation wizard; Microsoft's editing instructions instead use Agents and services. The licensing, ERP tool-call rate, premium exemptions and environment requirements are supported. The checklist also points readers to an access-control row for spending limits that the row does not configure.

claims.claim: Microsoft provides a Dynamics 365 ERP apps plugin for Copilot Cowork.
claims.quote: This article explains how to enable the Dynamics 365 ERP apps plugin for Microsoft Copilot Cowork.

claims.claim: The plugin lets Cowork users read and change finance and operations apps data.
claims.quote: Data tools – Read, create, update, and delete records in finance and operations apps data entities.

claims.claim: The plugin connects Cowork to a finance and operations environment through the Dynamics 365 ERP MCP server.
claims.quote: The Dynamics 365 ERP apps plugin connects Copilot Cowork to your finance and operations apps environment through the Dynamics 365 ERP MCP server.
